newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy 10-yr BTP spread over Bund at record low.
newsitem.headline: Italy 10-yr BTP spread over Bund at record low.

text.p: The spread between the benchmark February 2007 fixed rate Italian government bond (BTP) and the benchmark July 2007 Bund narrowed to a record level of 136 basis points in early trade.
The 10-year Btp was trading six basis points down on the day at 97.85 with a yield of 7.17 percent.
The Bund was trading at 101.33 with a yield of 5.82 percent at 0730 GMT.
